blockers.detail: DG-0008 is not registered: absent from improvements/taskrelation/research/STUDIES.jsonl and no studies/DG-0008/PLAN.md exists; the approved proposal is not yet a Study.

Raw corpus is unavailable: the cache volume carrying raw/ (speechcommand, voxceleb, iemocap) was deprovisioned 2026-09-30, the project records do not name the corpus sources, and IEMOCAP is licence-gated (LDC); lawful restoration and byte-identical example/split identity evidence (INPUT-RAW-CORPUS) are absent.

INPUT-EMBEDDINGS and INPUT-IDENTITY-MANIFEST are MISSING: no frozen canonical embedding SHA-256 set and no identity digest exist, so dual-identity admission (SI-DUAL-IDENTITY-ADMISSION) cannot be evaluated.

implementation.status is PLANNED with commit and entrypoint null and all three validation_commands PENDING: generate_opportunity_manifest.py, the manifest-driven sampler, the default-off auxiliary-loss hook, the fixed-LR diagnostic mode and the pinned-equality checks are not implemented or committed.
INPUT-COMPUTE-PLAN is MISSING: no committed studies/DG-0008/compute/{plan.json,inputs.json}; the DG-0001 S envelope is sanity-only and no job spec is duplicated in the workload.
No committed improvements/taskrelation/research/authorizations/DG-0008.yaml and no human price/spend/lifetime envelope; within_budget is null and unknown price or lifetime fails closed.

Five-epoch training-plus-validation duration for each of the four arm classes and the repeat is unmeasured in revision 2; the TR-0013 four-arm screen (~19-22 min/job) does not bound the 201-job DG-0008 matrix, so estimated_runtime and total GPU-hours remain null and no ceiling is claimed.

The selected compatible-GPU offer, its current hourly rate and the maximum paid lifetime are unknown; no provider query was made in this OPERATE slice, so offer/runtime/cost/lifetime remain unbounded.

The resolved embedded infra checkout (infra/, wavcse-infra v0.1.0, commit 6a2e2bddfe3589ab2433b090ab56e4a451fbf9a5) registers only doctor, config validate and worker *; improvements.compute.infra_cli requires volume list/show/cache stats, storage list/verify/read/download and job list/status/logs/submit/cancel, so the command-surface mismatch is unresolved and no job spec can be submitted.

The infra tree is DIRTY at commit 6a2e2bddfe3589ab2433b090ab56e4a451fbf9a5: six tracked infra files are modified (infra/AGENTS.md, infra/README.md, infra/controller/cloud-init.yaml, infra/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, infra/docs/OPERATIONS.md, infra/docs/SPEC.md), so no clean committed infra version is identifiable as the one that would operate the Study.

Stage 1 cannot start until the corpus, dual identity, compute plan, implementation and human authorization all exist; this blocker is independent of the satisfied CR-001 flexible revision, and this preflight grants none of proposal approval, registration, authorization or execution.

expected_bottlenecks: RESOLVED by revision 2: the avoidable opportunity-manifest materialisation bottleneck is cleared by IF-MANIFEST-IO=STREAM_CANONICAL_BYTES. Each per-epoch canonical object is streamed to its SHA-256 and to the frozen output instead of holding the whole S x 2048 matrix resident, preserving clause-5/11 J bytes, the clause-12 tuple-to-digest association and every per-epoch/run-level/matrix digest; peak memory is bounded with no scientific-invariant drift.
no compatible-GPU five-epoch benchmark exists, so runtime and cost stay null and cannot be bounded
unknown provider hourly price and unknown maximum paid lifetime leave spend unbounded

the resolved embedded infra checkout (infra/, v0.1.0, commit 6a2e2bd) registers only doctor, config validate and worker *, so volume, storage and job operations required by improvements.compute are unavailable and no job spec can be submitted
one live job workspace with at most two concurrent matrix jobs serialises the 201 trainings

This OPERATE slice must nonetheless BLOCK because the lifecycle gates are genuinely missing and independent of the flexible revision: DG-0008 is unregistered (absent from STUDIES.jsonl, no studies/DG-0008/PLAN.md); no committed improvements/taskrelation/research/authorizations/DG-0008.yaml exists so spend is undeclared, within_budget is null and unknown price/lifetime fails closed; the lawful raw corpus and byte-identical dual-identity evidence are absent; no committed studies/DG-0008/compute/{plan.json,inputs.json} exists; the implementation is PLANNED with no commit or entrypoint; no compatible-GPU benchmark bounds runtime/cost; and the resolved embedded infra checkout (commit 6a2e2bd, v0.1.0, DIRTY tree) lacks the volume/storage/job command surface that improvements.compute requires. A preflight grants none of proposal approval, registration, authorization or execution; no live resource was created and no scientific endpoint was read.

selected_strategy: Round-2 OPERATE strategy against corrected workload revision 2 (digest b0340df0c4bd69888367b1290d6803d130035472f78a024c5393c1eca58fe883). CR-001 is satisfied: IF-MANIFEST-IO=STREAM_CANONICAL_BYTES now equals the requested allowed value and every scientific invariant and other flexible-choice field is unchanged, so the Executor's flexible request is closed and no further implementation change is requested. Execution remains infeasible: 200 five-epoch matrix trainings plus one same-arm determinism repeat would run under exactly one job workspace and at most two concurrent jobs after the one-at-a-time gate members, on one compatible GPU no newer than sm_90 with a ~200 GB corpus volume attached at pod creation — but no compatible-GPU benchmark bounds runtime or cost, no human price/lifetime envelope exists, the lawful corpus and dual-identity evidence are absent, and the currently resolved embedded infra checkout lacks the volume/storage/job command surface, so no job spec can be submitted. This preflight stops before live execution and submits no job; no live resource, provider query or scientific endpoint was touched.
